Name: SlowDown
Overview:
Outrun your friends, escape from the police, avoid pigs, destroy your opponents, smash into zombies, drag a giant safe, take down the transporter, help your team member and weave through the traffic ... but never slow down.

SlowDown is an arcade style racing game and features:

- 5 unique tracks
- Different times of day and weather conditions
- 9 funny game modes
- 4 players
